description: Many conformance_* tests in integration.rs have no doc comment at all (e.g. conformance_email_get_by_id, conformance_mailbox_get_total_emails, conformance_email_body_plain_text_body, conformance_mailbox_set_state_changes). A failing test gives no indication of which RFC section the expected behaviour comes from or what the authoritative value is. The earlier-written tests follow the pattern '// Oracle: RFC 8620 §x.y — ...' which is sufficient. The conformance_ section should be consistent: each test needs at minimum a one-line doc comment citing the RFC section that mandates the behaviour.
title: integration.rs: conformance_* tests lack oracle source in doc comment
